profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kunz, Leigh & Associates
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the higher education and health industry. Skilled in .NET, JQuery, Bootstrap, Databases, and Project Management. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Business Administration (MBA) focused in Project Management from Walden University.

positions.title: Database Engineer
positions.description:
Perform database-related design and development in SQL / Oracle from defined client requirements.
Provide support and maintenance assistance to include but not limited to: diagnoses and resolution of database access and performance issues as well as inefficiencies, produce ad-hoc queries, and develop reports to support business needs while ensuring all database systems meet business and performance requirements.
Monitor, configure, migrate, troubleshoot, secure, optimize, and backup Oracle and SQL project databases.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer (contract)
positions.description: Responsible for the entire front-end of a new web and mobile friendly platform that provides a systemic way to help education leaders in schools, districts, and ed-focused organizations to drive, accelerate and sustain improvement. Specifically, it builds the capacity of education leaders to use data to set improvement targets, develop ambitious improvement plans, monitor their impact over time, and iterate on the process to ensure continuous improvement.

company.name: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst III
positions.description:
Designed and developed complex and functional software applications following the
software development life cycle (SDLC) and strict internal programming policies and
procedures.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst II
positions.description:
Learned and applied new design processes and technologies that emphasized better
performance for current and new program developing projects. Also, upgraded or replaced legacy stand-alone/web-based systems following strict internal programming guidelines and protocols.

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description:
Presented various Engineering and Computer Science topics to High School students
with the intention of recruiting for the College of Engineering at UTEP. The number of
students varied from 50 to 150, and covered information on the different Engineering
majors offered at UTEP, and job diversity engineering major graduates can seek after
obtaining their degree.
